newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SOLID GROUP CLIMBS 5.71 PCT IN LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: SOLID GROUP CLIMBS 5.71 PCT IN LATE TRADE.

text.p: Solid Group Inc rose 20 centavos, or 5.71 percent, to 3.70 pesos in late Thursday trade on expectations of better second half earnings, brokers said.

"I think people are looking at stronger earnings of the company for the remaining months of the year considering it's an exporter and will benefit from the peso's depreciation," said DBS Securities Corp analyst Jennifer Tan.
Solid reported on Wednesday a rise in net income to 355.99 million pesos for the first six months of the year, from 295 million in the year-earlier period.
"People are being selective and with Solid's higher income, the issue was bought up," said Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities.
Tan, however, said Solid's second quarter earnings were flat and it was the company's first quarter performance that pulled up its first half net income.
Solid was among the top ten most actively traded issues in late trade.
Solid is the sole franchise holder of Sony Corp and Aiwa Co Ltd products in the Philippines.
The company earlier said exports in 1997 are expected to grow by 40 percent. In 1996, its exports accounted for 32 percent of the company's sales.
